verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own docs show a snooze feature: messages are snoozed and return to the Inbox at a scheduled time. Nothing in the pack shows a reply-conditional follow-up reminder that resurfaces a thread only if nobody replies. Scheduled Send is a different feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: follow-up reminders conditional on no reply, conversation-level snooze detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of snooze.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: Snooze messages to just when you need them.
If you're offline when a snoozed message is scheduled to return to your Inbox, you will not see the snoozed message reappear until you're back online.
